variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 'and he commanded him to be kept' turns the clause finite, which is the ordinary English rendering of the participle keleusas as well as of the finite ekeleusen te auton.
ASV 'in Herod's palace' renders the genitive with or without the article tou.
ASV 'commanded him to be kept' has an object, but the reading omitting auton here carries the pronoun earlier in the clause, so the English does not show which position it held.
